citation.primary: Winstral, Jonas & Helbig (2017), Journal of Hydrometeorology 18:335-348, Eq. (1), DOI 10.1175/JHM-D-16-0054.1
citation.evidence_boundary: formula and parameter freeze directly supported; BARAM power/settlement gain near_match_only

formula.per_ray: max atan2(z(pixel_center) - (z(query_cell)+height_m), horizontal_distance_m) in degrees over every noncentral DEM cell whose footprint intersects the upwind segment through dmax_m
formula.sector: arithmetic mean of seven per-ray maxima centered on the 5-degree direction bin

parameters.dem_version_identity: object URL + SHA-256 + ETag + Last-Modified frozen at later extraction
parameters.query_locations: exact 16 LDAPS grid coordinates from frozen N14 audit

geometry.horizontal_reference: WGS84 local tangent plane independently centered at each query using meridional and prime-vertical radii of curvature
geometry.reason_for_root_freeze: At 300 m this avoids an undeclared UTM dependency while preserving metric distance and azimuth deterministically; the lane UTM suggestion was derived, not source-mandated.
geometry.raster_semantics: EPSG:4326 / PixelIsPoint; query elevation is native cell containing coordinate; candidate distance uses native pixel center; central cell excluded
geometry.primary_cell_traversal: integer supercover traversal of all pixel footprints intersected by the finite ray segment
geometry.independent_reference: brute-force segment-vs-closed-cell-footprint Liang-Barsky intersection over the bounded synthetic raster
geometry.endpoint_and_corner_rule: closed footprints; duplicates removed; if ray hits a shared boundary/corner, all intersected cells are included

prohibited: DEM GET or Range body in N19
